scientific_question: Does the introduction or re-introduction of a Binance USD-M USDT perpetual contract create a reproducible market-microstructure regime change for a token that already has an exact same-symbol Binance Spot USDT market?
economic_mechanism: A new perpetual market changes leverage access, short-sale access, hedging capacity, informed-trading capacity, liquidity competition and price discovery. No bullish or bearish return direction is assumed at Source Gate.

source.universe_route: S3 delimiter-only CommonPrefixes enumeration at data/futures/um/monthly/klines/

event_construction.event_timestamp: first open_time in earliest available in-window USD-M 1m monthly archive
event_construction.boundary_rule: exclude symbols with a December 2022 USD-M 1m monthly archive; later in-window appearance is treated as introduction or re-introduction
event_construction.spot_preexistence_rule: exact same-symbol Spot USDT archive evidence must prove Spot availability strictly before futures event timestamp

post_gate_rule: If SOURCE_DATA_PASS, STOP before outcomes and freeze a separate final pre-Discovery protocol. If not PASS, preserve the exact classification and do not lower minimums.
